note: Brief 008 B6 frame-time stops (Latch, 2026-10-14). GDD §11: 60 fps at 1080p on the MacBook Air M4, measured warm, in a development build. Foci are world points (Unity x, y, z = plan x, level, plan y); y is the level (0 street, 9.43 deck). zoom 0 = the play camera's own (14). PerfBuild resolves stand-offs with Rig.StandOff and the play camera's rotation (pitch 38, yaw 30). Redline review 008 B6 (out/review/008-b6-perf.html): passes, variants (A/B switches), warm-up to a plateau, rotated repeats, per-frame CSV; the sweep after a warm-up, by frame time, with the decks.
content: world only: buildings, structures, street furniture and bays; no people, vehicles or sim (not built yet)

passes.name: capped
